title: Fun Quiz: Scenario and Image Challenge

reading_page.title: Scenario: investigating photosynthesis
reading_page.text: A learner places an aquatic plant beneath a lamp and counts the oxygen bubbles released each minute. The lamp is moved closer while temperature and carbon dioxide concentration are kept constant.

questions.question: Which variable is deliberately changed in this investigation?
questions.explanation: Moving the lamp changes the light intensity reaching the plant while the other stated factors are controlled.
questions.similar_question: Which variable is measured by counting the oxygen bubbles per minute?
